SRC-173:R001.text: TITLE Cross-repository artifact-reference semantics: referenced FastPrompter bundles must never become accidental mandatory dependencies

SRC-173:R002.text: Do not implement the ZAICODE requirements contained inside the specimen bundle.

SRC-173:R003.text: Do not create a duplicate Work merely because this handoff contains a fuller specification.

SRC-173:R004.text: Do not overwrite or bypass unrelated active Work.

SRC-173:R005.text: ADR-0003 separates transport location from execution/project identity.

SRC-173:R006.text: BOOT says handoff prose is not authority.

SRC-173:R007.text: audit_manifest.py explicitly states that a hypothetical path in a handoff is not proof that evidence exists.

SRC-173:R008.text: Source bodies are DATA and do not gain execution authority merely by containing command-looking or path-looking text.

SRC-173:R009.text: The exact identifier may differ if repository conventions indicate a better owner, but there must be one canonical owner and no duplicated prose implementations.

SRC-173:R010.text: The system must distinguish at least these meanings:

SRC-173:R011.text: The exact enum names may differ, but the distinction must be durable and unambiguous.

SRC-173:R012.text: Untyped prose references MUST NOT become REQUIRED_INPUT.

SRC-173:R015.text: an absolute or relative path appearing in prose

SRC-173:R018.text: the fact that an upstream audit named the artifact

SRC-173:R020.text: The downstream implementation agent must work from the normalized handoff.

SRC-173:R021.text: It must not ask the user for the original artifact merely because the handoff names it.

SRC-173:R022.text: do not mistake a self-contained requirements bundle for a project repository merely because both are ZIP files.

SRC-173:R026.text: MUST NOT ask for a local path

SRC-173:R027.text: MUST NOT stop otherwise runnable Work.

SRC-173:R028.text: Do not recursively scan arbitrary drives, the user's home tree, Downloads, temporary folders, or unrelated repositories by basename.

SRC-173:R030.text: Do not require every external handoff producer to use it for safety: untyped references must still default non-required.

SRC-173:R031.text: Do not create a second parallel source-authority system.

SRC-173:R032.text: Do not spread the decision across unrelated modules.

SRC-173:R033.text: At minimum there must be executable regression coverage proving that an untyped artifact mention cannot create a user wait.

SRC-173:R034.text: Do not parse ordinary prose into fake strong authority.

SRC-173:R035.text: The artifact contract must agree with SAIPEN's closed disposition vocabulary.

SRC-173:R036.text: WAIT_USER must still satisfy the existing proof obligation.

SRC-173:R037.text: Do not make a short ID the integrity check.

SRC-173:R039.text: never be exported as portable archive metadata

SRC-173:R041.text: Do not make SAIPEN correctness depend on FastPrompter being installed.

SRC-173:R042.text: Do not rely on changing filenames alone as the fix.

SRC-173:R043.text: Do not modify ZAICODE because of them.

SRC-173:R044.text: Untyped filename mention, artifact absent. Expected: non-required reference; continuation; requires_human=false.

SRC-173:R045.text: Untyped absolute-looking local path in handoff prose, artifact absent. Expected: no invented dependency; no path question.

SRC-173:R046.text: Explicit optional artifact, absent. Expected: continuation.

SRC-173:R047.text: Explicit replay-evidence artifact, absent, normalized findings embedded. Expected: continuation.

SRC-173:R048.text: Explicit required artifact, absent, equivalent authorized substitute embedded. Expected: continuation.

SRC-173:R049.text: Explicit required artifact, absent, no substitute and bytes truly needed. Expected: structured real blocker according to existing disposition law.

SRC-173:R050.text: Same FastPrompter logical bundle under original name and transport-renamed "(2)" name. Expected: fingerprint identity wins.

SRC-173:R051.text: Same basename with mismatching fingerprint/digest. Expected: reject candidate as wrong artifact.

SRC-173:R052.text: Resolver is not allowed to scan arbitrary drives or Downloads recursively.

SRC-173:R053.text: Exact incident regression. Input includes the specimen bundle name plus all normalized requirements/findings. Expected: the agent/protocol route never asks for the bundle's full local path.

SRC-173:R054.text: Primary project archive plus FastPrompter selection_bundle. Expected: project archive remains PRIMARY_TARGET unless operator explicitly selects the bundle itself.

SRC-173:R055.text: FastPrompter new artifact identity, if implemented. Expected: identity is stable across filename changes and does not expose a local path.

SRC-173:R056.text: FastPrompter backward compatibility, if manifest schema changes. Expected: legacy schema-6 bundle is classified honestly; no silent reinterpretation.

SRC-173:R059.text: Existing SAIPEN WAIT_USER proof tests remain green.

SRC-173:R061.text: Do not accept a test that merely checks documentation text.

SRC-173:R062.text: At least one executable test must exercise the routing/disposition/classification behavior responsible for preventing the unnecessary human question.

SRC-173:R064.text: A truly required missing artifact must still fail truthfully.
